therapy: FDA approves bezuclastinib in combination with sunitinib for advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors
criteria: On November 24, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved bezuclastinib (Ekitna, Cogent Biosciences, Inc), a kinase inhibitor, in combination with sunitinib for the treatment of adults with advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GIST) who have received prior treatment with imatinib.

links.title: FDA approves bezuclastinib in combination with sunitinib for advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors

therapy: FDA approves giredestrant for adjuvant treatment of ER-positive, HER2-negative, Stage I, II, and III breast cancer at intermediate to high risk of recurrence
criteria: On November 23, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved giredestrant (Wilserdly, Genentech, Inc.), an oral estrogen receptor antagonist, as a single agent, for the adjuvant treatment of adults with estrogen receptor (ER)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative, Stage I, II, and III breast cancer at intermediate to high risk of recurrence.

links.title: FDA approves giredestrant for adjuvant treatment of ER-positive, HER2-negative, Stage I, II, and III breast cancer at intermediate to high risk of recurrence

therapy: FDA grants accelerated approval to neladalkib for previously treated locally advanced or metastatic ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer
criteria: On November 17, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval to neladalkib (Nelkarmi, Nuvalent, Inc.), a kinase inhibitor, for adults with locally advanced or metastatic anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who have previously received the following therapy in the unresectable locally advanced or metastatic setting:• one prior ALK tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) consisting of alectinib, or• two or more prior ALK TKIs and platinum-based chemotherapy.

links.title: FDA grants accelerated approval to neladalkib for previously treated locally advanced or metastatic ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer

therapy: FDA approves giredestrant in combination with everolimus for ER-positive, HER2-negative, ESR1-mutated locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
criteria: On November 16, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved giredestrant (Wilserdly, Genentech, Inc.), an oral estrogen receptor antagonist, in combination with everolimus for the treatment of adults with estrogen receptor (ER)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative, estrogen receptor 1 (ESR1)-mutated locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer, as detected by an FDA-authorized test, whose disease has recurred during or after completion of endocrine-based adjuvant therapy, or has progressed on at least one endocrine-based regimen in the metastatic setting.

links.title: FDA approves giredestrant in combination with everolimus for ER-positive, HER2-negative, ESR1-mutated locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer

therapy: FDA approves durvalumab with enfortumab vedotin-ejfv for muscle invasive bladder cancer
criteria: On November 13, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved durvalumab (Imfinzi, AstraZeneca) in combination with enfortumab vedotin-ejfv as neoadjuvant treatment, followed by single agent durvalumab as adjuvant treatment after radical cystectomy, for the treatment of adult patients with muscle invasive bladder cancer (MIBC) who are ineligible for or who have refused cisplatin based chemotherapy.

links.title: FDA approves durvalumab with enfortumab vedotin-ejfv for muscle invasive bladder cancer

therapy: FDA approves pimicotinib for symptomatic tenosynovial giant cell tumor
criteria: On November 10, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved pimicotinib (Pimjetmi, EMD Serono, Inc.), a kinase inhibitor, for adults with symptomatic tenosynovial giant cell tumor (TGCT) for which surgical resection may cause worsening functional limitation or severe morbidity.

links.title: FDA approves pimicotinib for symptomatic tenosynovial giant cell tumor

therapy: FDA grants accelerated approval to amivantamab and hyaluronidase-lpuj for recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
criteria: On November 5, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval to amivantamab and hyaluronidase-lpuj (Rybrevant Faspro, Janssen Biotech, Inc.) for adults with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) whose disease has progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherapy and an anti-PD-(L)1 antibody. Amivantamab and hyaluronidase-lpuj is not indicated for patients with oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) that is HPV-associated.

links.title: FDA grants accelerated approval to amivantamab and hyaluronidase-lpuj for recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

therapy: FDA approves talazoparib with enzalutamide for metastatic androgen pathway modulation-naïve or -sensitive prostate cancer with HRR gene mutations
criteria: On October 26, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved talazoparib (Talzenna, Pfizer Inc.) in combination with enzalutamide for the treatment of adults with metastatic androgen pathway modulation-naïve or -sensitive (mAPMN/S) prostate cancer with homologous recombination repair (HRR) gene mutations, as detected by an FDA-authorized test.

links.title: FDA approves talazoparib with enzalutamide for metastatic androgen pathway modulation-naïve or -sensitive prostate cancer with HRR gene mutations

therapy: FDA grants traditional approval for pembrolizumab or pembrolizumab and berahyaluronidase alfa-pmph for unresectable or metastatic TMB-H solid tumors with updated indication

links.title: FDA approves eflornithine for adult and pediatric patients with high-risk neuroblastoma

therapy: FDA grants accelerated approval to pirtobrutinib for chronic lymphocytic leukemia and small lymphocytic lymphoma
criteria: On December 1, 2023, the Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval to pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca, Eli Lilly and Company) for adults with chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma (CLL/SLL) who have received at least two prior lines of therapy, including a BTK inhibitor and a BCL-2 inhibitor.

links.title: FDA grants accelerated approval to pirtobrutinib for chronic lymphocytic leukemia and small lymphocytic lymphoma

therapy: FDA approves nirogacestat for desmoid tumors
criteria: On November 27, 2023, the Food and Drug Administration approved nirogacestat (OGSIVEO, SpringWorks Therapeutics, Inc.) for adult patients with progressing desmoid tumors who require systemic treatment. This is the first approved treatment for desmoid tumors.

links.title: FDA approves nirogacestat for desmoid tumors

links.title: FDA approves enzalutamide for non-metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer with biochemical recurrence

links.title: FDA approves capivasertib with fulvestrant for breast cancer

therapy: FDA approves pembrolizumab with chemotherapy for HER2-negative gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
criteria: On November 16, 2023, the Food and Drug Administration approved pembrolizumab (Keytruda, Merck) with fluoropyrimidine- and platinum-containing chemotherapy for the first-line treatment of adults with locally advanced unresectable or metastatic HER2-negative gastric or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) adenocarcinoma.

links.title: FDA approves pembrolizumab with chemotherapy for HER2-negative gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma

therapy: FDA approves repotrectinib for ROS1-positive non-small cell lung cancer

links.title: FDA approves repotrectinib for ROS1-positive non-small cell lung cancer

therapy: FDA approves fruquintinib in refractory metastatic colorectal cancer

links.title: FDA approves fruquintinib in refractory metastatic colorectal cancer

therapy: FDA amends pembrolizumab’s gastric cancer indication
criteria: On November 7, 2023, the Food and Drug Administration revised the existing indication of pembrolizumab (Keytruda, Merck) with trastuzumab, fluoropyrimidine, and platinum-containing chemotherapy for the first-line treatment of patients with locally advanced unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive gastric or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) adenocarcinoma. links.title: FDA amends pembrolizumab’s gastric cancer indication

therapy: FDA approves pembrolizumab with chemotherapy for biliary tract cancer
criteria: On October 31, 2023, the Food and Drug Administration approved pembrolizumab (Keytruda, Merck) to be used with gemcitabine and cisplatin for locally advanced unresectable or metastatic biliary tract cancer (BTC).

links.title: FDA approves pembrolizumab with chemotherapy for biliary tract cancer

therapy: FDA approves toripalimab-tpzi for nasopharyngeal carcinoma

links.title: FDA approves toripalimab-tpzi for nasopharyngeal carcinoma

therapy: FDA approves ivosidenib for myelodysplastic syndromes

links.title: FDA approves ivosidenib for myelodysplastic syndromes

therapy: FDA expands pediatric indication for entrectinib and approves new pellet formulation

links.title: FDA expands pediatric indication for entrectinib and approves new pellet formulation

therapy: FDA approves neoadjuvant/ adjuvant pembrolizumab for resectable non-small cell lung cancer

links.title: FDA approves neoadjuvant/ adjuvant pembrolizumab for resectable non-small cell lung cancer

therapy: FDA approves nivolumab for adjuvant treatment of Stage IIB/C melanoma

links.title: FDA approves bosutinib for pediatric patients with chronic myelogenous leukemia

therapy: FDA approves new and updated indications for temozolomide under Project Renewal

links.title: FDA approves new and updated indications for temozolomide under Project Renewal

therapy: FDA approves melphalan as a liver-directed treatment for uveal melanoma

links.title: FDA approves melphalan as a liver-directed treatment for uveal melanoma

therapy: FDA grants accelerated approval to elranatamab-bcmm for multiple myeloma

links.title: FDA grants accelerated approval to talquetamab-tgvs for relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma

therapy: FDA approves pralsetinib for non-small cell lung cancer with RET gene fusions

links.title: FDA approves pralsetinib for non-small cell lung cancer with RET gene fusions

links.title: FDA approves quizartinib for newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia
